tools.name: california_court_holidays
tools.description: List every California judicial holiday for a given year, with the date it is observed. These are the days excluded when counting court days and the days a deadline rolls off under Code of Civil Procedure section 12a. Includes the weekend-observed shifts, which are the ones most often got wrong.

tools.name: california_court_day_check
tools.description: Say whether a given date is a California court day, and if it is not, give the next date it would roll forward to under Code of Civil Procedure section 12a. Use this before asserting that a filing date or a deadline falls on a working day.
